observations: Single-needle flatbed industrial sewing machine on a wooden table, photographed from above.
Machine body is teal/blue with blue text reading "AIG BROTHER" visible on the housing (photo 0).
No motor, pedal, stand legs, or power cable visible in the frame; only the head and table top are shown.
A ruler/measuring tape is printed on the table edge, likely for scale reference, not part of the item.
Watermark overlay reads "POSTED ON JIJI NANCY ANAEBO", indicating the photo is a listing screenshot.
No needle, thread path, or stitch sample is clearly visible to confirm stitching quality.
Surface shows some light speckling/wear on the paint but no obvious rust or major damage.

claims.claim: Original Ambro Brother embroidery Sewing machine
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the brand text as 'AIG BROTHER', not 'Ambro Brother'; also the machine's single-needle flatbed design matches a standard lockstitch industrial sewing machine, not an embroidery machine.
No stitch sample, operation video, or stress test shown; durability cannot be judged from a static photo.
No fabric sample or stitch close-up provided to confirm stitch quality.

risks.risk: Machine may be missing motor, pedal, and stand, which are usually sold with industrial machines and affect usability/price.
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the full setup including motor, pedal, and table legs underneath.

risks.risk: Mechanical condition (needle bar movement, bobbin case, tension) unknown; could be seized or faulty.
risks.proof: A short video of the machine running and stitching a sample on fabric.

risks.risk: Brand/model mismatch between seller's text ('Ambro Brother') and photo text ('AIG Brother') raises doubt about authenticity or listing accuracy.
risks.proof: A clearer close-up photo of the nameplate/model sticker, ideally with serial number.
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded/generic industrial machine rather than a verified brand model

risks.risk: Possible hidden rust, cracked housing, or missing small parts (bobbin, foot) not visible in the single overhead shot.
risks.proof: Additional photos from multiple angles including underside and accessory tray.
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming parts may be missing or worn

proof_requests: Clear close-up of the nameplate/model number and serial number.
Video of the machine powered on and stitching a sample seam.
Photo showing the full machine setup including motor, pedal, and stand/legs.
Photos from additional angles (side, underside, back) to check for rust or damage.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an industrial flatbed sewing machine with visible brand text 'AIG BROTHER', but the seller's embroidery and brand claims are contradicted by the photo, and key completeness/working details are unverified, so it must be priced at worst case (head-only, unverified function, generic brand).
